en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural railway station with wooden buildings beside train tracks. Several people stand on the platform in front of the main station house. A separate signal or control tower stands to the right, with trees and a garden area nearby. The sky is filled with scattered clouds. Swedish text is printed in the lower left corner and a photographer credit appears in the lower right.
